p, k = map(int, input().split())

u = [0] * (p)
ans = 1
mod = 10**9 + 7

def dfs(v):
    u[v] = 1
    x = (k * v) % p
    if not u[x]:
        dfs(x)

i = 1
if k == 1:
    i = 0

for i in range(i, p):
    if not u[i]:
        dfs(i)
        ans = (ans * p) % mod

print(ans)
</translated_code>
